title: Izwi Lokuqina
intro: Lo muntu ukhunjulwa ngokuhlakanipha okujulile kanye nesiqondiso, enikeza iseluleko esidlula izizukulwane. Amazwi abo ayibufakazi bobungcwele kanye nokubaluleka kokuqaphela izibusiso nezilingo ezivela kuNkulunkulu. Yembula ubunjalo balo mphefumulo ohlonishwayo.
clues: Ngangingeyena umprofethi, kodwa ukuhlakanipha kwami ​​​​akufi emiBhalweni Engcwele.
Iseluleko sami engasinika ingane yami sasigcizelela ukubonga u-Allah nokugwema i-shirk.
Ngafundisa ngokubaluleka komthandazo, ukuyala okuhle, kanye nokwenqabela okubi.
Igama lami linikezwe isahluko sonke ku-Quran, siqokomisa izimfundiso zami.
Iseluleko sami sasihlanganisa ukubekezela ebunzimeni, ngoba empeleni, lokho kuvela ezindabeni eziqinile kakhulu.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
